artboards.title: Settings · Personas — the full surface, moved in
Rail foot · persona switcher · account · log out

annotations.text: S4 scope, on the shipped S1 registry: the LIST paints four shelves — USER (Personas · Appearance · Chat behavior · Jobs · Backup & Restore), APP (Connections · Automation · Admin), COLLECTIONS (Tags · Regex · World info · Saved rosters), EXTENSIONS (Plugins). Settings sits at the RAIL FOOT (gear, above your avatar). Appearance leads with LOOKS in three tiers by frequency: PICK (the three shipped themes as fixed cards — a closed set that never grows; picking applies, theme-not-mode), MANAGE (Your themes — imported and builder-made looks as LIST rows with a ⋯ menu: Apply · Edit in builder · Export · Delete — scales to any count, searchable via @in:appearance), MAKE (one builder door, "New theme from <current>"; every color decision lives in the builder — no freestanding accent knob, so a color tweak always mints a named theme of yours instead of silently forking the picked one). Personas migrates IN FULL — list, editor, world books, this-chat override; only the pin/active resolution mechanics are frozen. The rail's persona slot: switch persona · who you're signed in as · log out. Per #297 APPLY-NOT-MODE: a Look is an applied BASE, never a mode; the Density/Motion/Reading knobs sit behind the explicit "Customize this look" arm (drawn expanded here; collapsed by default), and snap's appearance-preset arms stay instrument-only — no product preset system. The QUICK surface (rail popover) carries only what travels with a switch, by frequency: the switch list, an Applies scope (everywhere / this chat — the per-chat override without opening Settings), and the contextual re-attribute action for your messages in the open room; create/edit/import stay in Settings. Total clicks: switch = 2, switch-for-this-chat = 3, switch+re-attribute = 3. TEACHER LAW (owner 2026-08-30): explanatory prose NEVER lives in the content rows — a row is label + control; the CONTEXT pane is the teacher, keyed to the focused row (About · Applies · Learn via SettingTeach/configFocus, S3). Both desktop boards draw a focused row (outlined) with its teach in context. PIN, not crown (the crown already means host-only in this app — the Game door): every switcher row carries an inline pin — solid on the pinned/default persona, faint on hover elsewhere, CLICK TO PIN. "playing" stays the current marker; the two coincide outside a chat and diverge visibly inside one with an override.
